# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| Latest release | :white_check_mark: |
| `main` branch | :white_check_mark: |
| Older releases | :x: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

If GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled for this repository, use
that channel from the Security tab. Otherwise, contact the maintainer through
GitHub and include enough detail to reproduce the issue safely.

Acknowledgements are typically sent within 72 hours, followed by status updates
as triage and remediation progress.
